title: Defeat the Blade Masters
description: Defeat the Blade Masters — The Townstons wiki
html:
Blademaster

Quest Giver: Kingdom Representative

Quest Type: Hunt

Quest Description: Kill 6 Whisker Blademasters in Dew Valley

Quest Reward: 500 Gold and 1 Kings Coin

Return to: Kingdom Representative

Repeatable: No

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Kill 6 Whisker Blademasters in Dew Valley Forest. Afterward, return to Sir Prize the Kingdom Representative in Dew Valley.

Offer:

There have been disturbing reports of Whisker elite guards attacking innocent civilians in the Dew Valley Forest.

I'm certain this is the work of Rattle Tooth, a local Whisker boss. I've heard his lair is crawling with elite guards of this type.

If you should find any of these foul creatures, they should be destroyed.

Once you have killed 6 Whisker Blademasters, return to me, Sir Prize the Kingdom Representative, here in Dew Valley.

Turn-in:

The Whisker nation will feel this sting of losing some of their elite guards.

Objectives:

  • Slay Whisker Blademasters

Client level range: 2–15
